section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the importance of positive eating behaviors, focusing on intuitive eating. It introduces the concept of online interpersonal sexual objectification (OISO) experiences and hypothesizes a negative association between OISO and intuitive eating, mediated by broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation. The section highlights gaps in previous research, particularly the lack of focus on OISO in online contexts and non-Western samples, which 'the present study' aims to address.
